eventDetail.scope: The OITS International Conference on Information Technology (OCIT) is a premier international forum for high quality research in the areas of Information Technology. OCIT 2026 is a premier international forum for high-quality Information Technology research, jointly organized by the Orissa Information Technology Society (OITS) and NIT Kurukshetra. We invite researchers and industry practitioners to present their findings on a wide range of emerging IT topics and applications. The conference is technically co-sponsored by the IEEE Delhi Section, with proceedings intended for publication in IEEE Xplore.
